claim: The completed Astra and Claude research results match their native local usage telemetry. Astra also has an exactly correlated bounded SDK result observation. Seven current Prometheus targets were healthy.
scope: Read-only reconciliation of the coordinator's existing successful paired research run; no models or readiness checks were rerun.

sdk_result_observation.correlation_method: Unique local observation within five seconds of native receipt completion, matching model, duration, status and complete total usage; exact private observation_id and receipt_id matched in Loki.

usage_reconciliation.native_to_telemetry_correlation: Unique fresh process in the bounded run window, matching model, timestamp and all four exact usage categories; shared private process instance directly joins Loki and Prometheus.

native_commands.purpose: Correlate the bounded SDK result observation by exact private ID
Read the exact Astra process records, discovering its retained service name
Read the bounded Claude research process events; accepted result had one instance
Read Astra's six native token categories at the run's evaluation time
Read Claude's four native token categories at the same evaluation time
Read current scrape-target health; publish counts only

limitations: This reconciles an existing successful native model pair. It does not rerun Dagu/LEAN, establish clean second-machine acceptance or demonstrate every MCP tool or foundation service.
Astra cached-input tokens are already included in input; reasoning-output tokens are included in output. Last and total usage views and provisional/final SSE events must not be added together.
Claude thinking tokens are already included in output. Cache-creation duration buckets and per-iteration/model usage views duplicate the top-level usage and are not added again.
The combined37069 count sums two native model reports. It is not a whole-task token-savings or billing measurement; the models can use different tokenizers.

Claude's native session ID is not retained in these Loki records. Native-to-telemetry attribution uses the unique bounded process/time/model and exact category agreement, while Loki-to-Prometheus uses an exact private instance ID.
The SDK result receipt does not persist its observation ID in the native result file. The uniquely matching local observation supplies the ID for exact Loki matching.

The initial guessed Astra service_name=codex query returned zero. Querying its exact private instance across retained service names found codex-app-server and18 records; the initial empty selector was not treated as missing telemetry.

Native Claude stdout hook lifecycle records and OTel hook execution events are different views with different counts; neither is added to token usage. Zero exposed tools limits what this inference proves about tool execution.
Raw IDs, prompts, model response bodies, local paths and authentication stores are excluded from this receipt. All queried log bodies were redacted.
The pre-login failed readiness observation remains a separate historical receipt. Its unknown usage is not mixed into this completed pair.
